title: And Then Came the Savior
subtitle: The flood of time will take us all, but pray, let me find my own stream.

content.text: Heavy rain will eventually cause a flood. It's an obvious deduction.
This is my final report. The era of mankind and birds is over, and the era of fish has begun.
But the fish will have to wait a little longer. Because you've delayed the doomsday by about an hour.
Every living person now owes you an hour of their lives. How big do you think your medal should be?

branch.text: Certainly. Even if the umbrellas don't work, you still have an ark.
Just as long as you only take the "qualified animals" with you, like in old times ...
You should be able to continue to fight.
Please, let me finish my final report, even if you don't want to hear it.
Thanks to gravity, those on higher ground live longer in a flood.
Which gives you plenty of time to cuddle up with your greyhound and watch the end of the world together.
Or ... you could do what a soldier would and follow your orders till the very last moment.
You know how important this mission is.

items.text: And Then Came the Savior
Altar, Sanctuary

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Aah. What an honor it is to bear witness to Her return with my own eyes! Great Mother of Arcanum—

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Guide us! Protect us, in your infinite might! Let the "Flood" come! Let all be reshaped! Bring forth the primordial garden!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Arcana ...
The resurrected deity lifts one of her endless hands and taps the air.
Liquid erupts from the well, swallowing everything it touches.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Look.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Stay away from that liquid! It's no ordinary water.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's spilling out from that well. Are you attempting another "Storm"?

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: "Storm"? AHAHAHAHA!

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Oh, to be so blissfully ignorant of Her true power.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: This is no mere "Storm."

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: This is a gift from the Inculcator of Arcanum.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: A great "Flood" that will return this world to primal chaos!
Antarctic Sea

items.speaker: Crewman I
items.text: Captain! Sir! We're sinking.

items.speaker: Crewman I
items.text: The water is rising fast. It's flooding over the deck.

items.speaker: Captain II
items.text: Stay calm! Find the breach and seal it immediately.

items.speaker: Crewman I
items.text: But, it's not seawater, sir.

items.speaker: Crewman II
items.text: Captain! Report on the enemy's status!

items.speaker: Captain II
items.text: What is it?

items.speaker: Crewman II
items.text: Manus Vindictae have halted their attack! They're chanting on the deck.

items.speaker: Captain II
items.text: Chanting?
Faint chanting echoes from the frozen coast.

items.speaker: Believers
items.text: Tides run in blind by their ever-be routine,

items.speaker: Believers
items.text: Staining that Heaven with obscene calamity.

items.speaker: Believers
items.text: The breaker of death's shackles shall rule us all,

items.speaker: Believers
items.text: From this day forth, and evermore.

items.speaker: Captain II
items.text: All units, stay at your posts! Wait for my order!
The captain steps toward the flood pouring from the inner cabin.

items.speaker: Crewman I
items.text: Captain, something isn't right with this water.
His boots are already submerged.

items.speaker: Captain II
items.text: What the hell?

items.speaker: Captain II
items.text: My feet ... I can't ... They're gone!
Everything below the waterline dissolves, vanishing into the flood without a trace. His body is severed cleanly—no blood, no pain, as if it was never there.
The water reflects no present image, only ruins from ten years, a hundred years, millions of years ago.
Numberless waterbirds gather in flocks, dive, and melt into the "Flood" like flames joining a fire, turning from the many into one.

items.speaker: Crewman II
items.text: Arghhhhhhh!
The first scream erupts from a young soldier. He clutches his head and scrambles for higher ground.
But before his second cry for help can escape, the flood swallows him whole.

items.speaker: Believers
items.text: The blessing of the coming age is near. And, humbly, we kneel to receive such grace.

items.speaker: Believers
items.text: O Glorious One, walk the Earth again—

items.speaker: Believers
items.text: Shape this land with your mighty, vengeful hands!

items.speaker: Crewman I
items.text: Captain!

items.speaker: Captain II
items.text: This flood ... Creius warned me about this.

items.speaker: Captain II
items.text: Equilibrium Umbrellas open, everyone! Get Admiral Somme on the line!
Umbrella handles are lifted, the canopies blazing with light.

items.speaker: Captain II
items.text: This is just another "Storm." The umbrella's will—
Yet before the words are spoken, the flood devours them whole, and soon after, the Equilibrium Umbrellas too.
One by one, umbrellas and their bearers dissolve into the water.
The soldiers' screams and the Manus seabeasts' roars clash. Then silence. Absolute silence.
Former Zeno Sentinel Unit Station

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: It is happening again. Just like in 1999.
The admiral watches the distant fleet sink beneath the waves.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: To a commander, troops are just numbers on the sand table, pieces on a chessboard.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: But in the face of a calamity, what can a foot soldier do? Many men and women have been marched to their deaths, cannon fodder for the cause—a "necessary sacrifice" ...

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: And their loyalty and passion turned to dust in an instant.
The sea climbs faster now, the coastal ice shelves already gone. Only a pristine flood remains, like a veil of translucent gauze wiping away all impurities.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Father, Moldir's men have arrived.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Good. Has the team been mustered?

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Yes, including the wounded from the Manus Vindictae attack. Everyone's here except Captain Danilov ...

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: ... and Moldir. She wasn't with the team when they arrived.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: I see.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Prepare to move. We are breaking camp.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Yes, sir. Where to?

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: Somewhere safe. Somewhere the "Flood" cannot reach us.
From his coat, the admiral draws the black box. It rotates in slow motion over his palm, emitting faint golden light.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Is that what we got from the Manus deal?
He nods.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: It is. From this day on, we are taking a different path. One without fruitless sacrifice.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: But Moldir is still ...

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: She is walking her own path.
Igor looks out toward the distant snowy peaks, seeing instead the long road that brought him to this moment.

items.speaker: Admiral Igor
items.text: I have faith in her decision.
Mountainside, Sanctuary

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Restless critters, rising sea level, abnormal avalanches ...

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: It's the Manus ritual. It's already begun. We need to do something before it's too late!

items.speaker: Guard
items.text: You've got to be kidding me. Boss, this isn't exactly the time for chit-chat!

items.speaker: Buddy Fairchild
items.text: Avalanche incomin'! All units, change course! Follow me, now!
The guard hoists up the still-analyzing researcher and charges uphill at full speed.

items.speaker: Buddy Fairchild
items.text: Heads up! Snow's comin' down! Anchor yourselves!

items.speaker: Guard
items.text: Ergh!
In the collapsing snowfield, the guard struggles to steady herself, but the sheer force of the avalanche overwhelms them both.
A massive snow chunk slams into them, sending Ulrich's tank spinning into the void.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Ah! For Flux's—

items.speaker: Guard
items.text: BOSS!
The glass tank's arc ends in a pair of steady hands.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Phew. We made it just in time.
In the howling wind, black hair escapes from under her hat.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: It's them, Captain Danilov. Lower the altitude and release the ladder.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Over here, all of you!
Yet despite the roaring gale, her voice rings out clear and strong.

items.speaker: Buddy Fairchild
items.text: Lieutenant Moldir!

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: My apologies. We should've come sooner.
The guard shoves Ulrich's body into the cabin. With help from Moldir, the two groups finally merge.
Miraculously, aside from some surface damage to Ulrich's glass container, no arcanists or penguins are harmed.

items.speaker: Buddy Fairchild
items.text: Hooey, Lieutenant! You got here just in the nick o' time.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: That's quite enough.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: The sea level is rising, but not with any ordinary water. This is something far worse than we have ever seen. Something even more destructive than the "Storm."

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: At this rate, it will soon wipe this era from the face of the Earth.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: I figured as much. An event of this scale and severity could only be the result of the Manus ritual. We must act now.
Ulrich reattaches his head, then pulls out the apparatus for "asymmetrical nuclide R." The ferrofluid churns in his tank, unfazed by the shifting gale.
The apparatus fills with golden liquid in the blink of an eye.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: This "Flood" looks different from the "Storm," yes, but the sudden surge in the level of asymmetrical nuclide R in the air suggests they come from the same source.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Or, to take a leap, they are one and the same. The "Flood" is the "Storm."

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: So, the "Regulus" record might still work?

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: You're a quick learner, Lieutenant.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: If the record can slow the progression of the Storm Syndrome, then it stands to reason that it might do the same for the ritual.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Time is against us. We need to place the record and generate the immunity zone as soon as possible.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Which means we need to reach the mountaintop. It's the only location where we can be sure the ritual site will fall within its radius.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Captain Danilov!

items.speaker: Aircraft Captain
items.text: I heard him, ma'am! Hold tight, everyone!
No orders are needed between seasoned soldiers. The Canis Minor tilts upward, propellers screaming.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: The sea level is rising fast. Do you think we still stand a chance once we get there?

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: I can't say for certain, but I have faith. I'm sure the Timekeeper is doing everything she can to hold off the ritual for us.
Despite the chaotic wind, Ulrich's voice holds steady.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: If there's one thing I've learned from all my years of research, Lieutenant,

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: it's that you give it your all and trust your collaborators to do the same.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The water's rising quickly. At this rate, we'll all be underwater in a matter of minutes.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We must disrupt the ritual before the "Flood" drowns us all.
Rituals, mist, the "Flood"—all twist around the grotesque colossus.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Attack Arcana. Maybe we can find a weakness!

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: G-Got it!
A lead arrow splits the thick air, embedding itself beside Nautika's twitching talons.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Hah! What a farce.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: A few squirming little insects think they can defy fate's design!

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: This world you so desperately cling to is naught but the poisonous fruits of a corrupted tree—rotten to the very core.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Watch as it falls to pieces. Watch as the "Flood" washes away all the impurities of this world and returns us to what should have been!
"Arcana" shifts, her blurred face showing a familiar smile.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: The Mother has awakened! O Great Lady, I kneel before You. Enlighten us with Your divine knowledge!

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Grant us Your benevolent might! Bring down Your mighty hand of vengeance!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Nautika, watch out for the black mucus!

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Hold on, team!
Nautika spreads her wings, charging headfirst into a storm of black arrows.
At the last possible moment, Nautika folds her wings and slips into the narrow gap between the flood and piercing arrows.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Ugh! Is everyone okay?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You're burned! Let me take care of that.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: I'm fine, really, I am! Just hold onto me!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You're injured, Nautika. We can't dodge these attacks forever.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: You're right.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Then, tell me, Vertin. Tell me what to do.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: I'm still not used to this body. I need your guidance.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Just give the word, Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We'll make it through this, together.
Wings spread open again toward the sky, while her friends hold their ground below.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: All this writhing and squirming—it is utterly in vain!

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: The "Flood" shall summon the creatures of the Blank Era.
Her words dig deep into the bone.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: And your elimination, along with those pitiful beings sneaking atop the sanctuary, shall serve as its foundation!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: They ... Timekeeper, Mr. Ulrich might be in danger!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Don't act in haste, Sonetto.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We'll do what we can from down here. Keep Animus engaged. Draw her attention away from Mr. Ulrich.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And if possible, keep an eye out for Dr. Dores.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Understood.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Vertin! The water just keeps getting higher. I'm running out of space to fly in.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You're right. We need to make more space.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Can you break through these walls?

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: B-Break the walls?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes, just like you did earlier when you kicked those rocks.
Ahead looms the grotesque deity, her form tethered to the sanctuary by endless pulsing black veins.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The entire sanctuary is feeding power to Arcana.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: If we can break these walls, we may be able to slow down her recovery. We can also use the falling debris to attack the believers below, and create more space for us to stay above the "Flood."

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: Okay. I'll give it my all.
Crater, Sanctuary

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: We've reached the target area. The sanctuary is directly below us.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: This will be a race against the clock.
Before the helicopter can even stabilize, Moldir leaps out, guiding Ulrich from the cabin.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Now's the time. Give me a hand with the record player while I generate the magnetic field.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Damn it! The field is totally unstable. I can't accurately calibrate the record player under these conditions.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: The asymmetrical nuclide R in the air is far denser than anything we've ever had in the lab.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: There are too many variables. There's no way to be sure that "Regulus" will function as expected.
The ferrofluid fractures into scattered dots, then coalesces.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Calm down, Ulrich. First, get the latest asymmetrical nuclide R reading and make the necessary adjustments. Then we'll deal with the signal interference. If I can find the pattern of the geomagnetic change—

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: For Flux's sake! The device is frozen. Somebody help me out here.
Another quake in ice and earth all but topples Ulrich. Above, Olitiau's screech pierces the air.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Be careful, Ulrich.
Moldir steadies Ulrich just in time.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Leave the monitoring device to me. I can fix it. Buddy, keep those creatures off of us.

items.speaker: Buddy Fairchild
items.text: Ain't gotta tell me twice. But, Lieutenant, that thing don't look like no Olitiau I ever seen.
A great boney creature spreads its wings and dives toward them, followed by a swarm of Olitiaus, eager to feast.

items.speaker: Buddy Fairchild
items.text: Heavens to Betsy! Now this'll be a tough nut to crack.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Prepare to engage. Hold them off while Ulrich works on the record. There is no room for error.
Crater, Sanctuary

items.speaker: Buddy Fairchild
items.text: Goshdarnit! These birds 're meaner 'n a two-headed snake and twice as tenacious!

items.speaker: Penguins
items.text: Uragh!

items.speaker: Guard
items.text: Captain Danilov's spiraling. I can't hold on much longer. Come on, Captain, let go! That's my chocolate MRE!

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Ulrich. Hurry it up.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Materials, check. Location, check. Environmental factors, check.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Flux! It's just not working. I must've got the magnetic poles wrong again.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Experiment number 22. Last chance.

items.speaker: Guard
items.text: Oh, but, just forget it, boss. We have to go before Danilov crashes us all to the ground.
Moldir hurls the squirrel and penguins all into the cabin in a heap before making the jump herself.

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Give me your hand, Ulrich. That's an order.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: Program set. Parameters confirmed. Initiating.
With a yank on Ulrich's collar, Moldir hauls him skyward, just as he presses the needle onto the record for the twenty-second time.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: The magnetic field—it's stabilizing. It worked.

items.speaker: Ulrich
items.text: We did it!

items.speaker: Moldir
items.text: Look. The water's stopped rising.
Altar, Sanctuary

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Do you hear that? It's Regulus's song.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: And look, the "Flood" has stopped. Mr. Ulrich made it.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Nautika, this is our chance.
With the pounding beat of the song, the last pillar crumbles under Nautika's strike.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: I-I did it.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Well done, Nautika.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But stay sharp. The sanctuary's coming apart. Watch out for falling debris.
Nautika weaves through crashing boulders. With a final quake, the altar collapses into ruin.
Rubble buries all life below, only the edges of the believers' black robes still visible beneath the crush of stone.

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Urgh ...

items.speaker: Animus
items.text: Blasphemous little ...
Another stone falls. A gasp, a spurt of blood, then silence.

items.speaker: Nautika
items.text: We should be safe here.
Nautika extends her wings, careful of the narrow space, sheltering the pair from both the "Flood" and falling rocks.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Everything's been buried beneath the "Flood."

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: And yet Arcana ...

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: The body dissolves, reshaping into a familiar human silhouette.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: She stands on the surface of the "Flood" on her toes, watching the sanctuary collapse.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: A dirge to mark the end of this world. How fitting.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Shh ...
Only her voice remains, echoing through the void.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: When the final note falls, the "Flood" shall rise once more.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: An ancient era shall be reclaimed, and a new order forged.
Arcana stands in the water, smiling all the same.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: The end is nigh. But do take solace in thine achievement, my little savior, that this world should draw its final breath on a tune and not a scream. But alas, this is no true end for you.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: We shall meet again, Vertin.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: In a world that is rightfully ours.
Then she disappears into the rising tide.
TO BE CONTINUED…
